description.value: City Pizza is a pizza-focused fast-food counter in Abbotsford offering an unusually broad menu that blends classic North American pies with South Asian-inspired options like Butter Chicken, Tandoori Chicken, and Shahi Paneer pizzas. The shop offers both delivery and quick pickup, with a full menu of pizzas, pasta, wings, burgers, wraps, and lassi drinks. Customer reviews highlight friendly staff and consistent quality, making it a viable calorie stop for cyclists passing through the Clearbrook corridor.
